biography: Kel Treseder, a name synonymous with inconsistency and raw talent in Australian motorsport, hails from the dusty plains of rural New South Wales. His journey began not on a racetrack, but on the back of a beat-up ute, hurtling across the family farm's dirt tracks. This early exposure to speed and the unpredictable nature of loose surfaces instilled in him a fearless, albeit sometimes reckless, driving style. Treseder's professional debut came relatively late, at 24, in the Australian V8 Ute Series, where his natural ability shone through, often overshadowed by his aggressive maneuvers that frequently ended in spectacular crashes. After a brief stint in Supercars, marked by flashes of brilliance interspersed with costly errors, Treseder found a home in the GT ranks. Now, at 38, and driving for the Bebeto Tyres team, Treseder remains a captivating figure, capable of snatching victory from the jaws of defeat or throwing it all away in a moment of madness. He’s a wildcard, a veteran who still races with the untamed spirit of his youth.
drivingStyle: Treseder's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward affair. He's known for his late-braking overtakes and his uncanny ability to wrestle a car back from the brink of disaster. He's aggressive on corner entry, often pushing the limits of grip, and while this sometimes results in breathtaking passes, it can also lead to costly mistakes. Tire management isn't his strong suit; he tends to burn through rubber in the early stages of a race, relying on his raw speed to compensate. Under pressure, Treseder can either rise to the occasion with a stunning display of skill or crack under the weight, making erratic decisions that jeopardize his chances.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision in the 2018 Bathurst 12 Hour race, where Treseder's aggressive move forced Bellini into the wall, costing him the lead.

rivalries.name: Zara Petrova
rivalries.reason: A clash of personalities and driving styles. Petrova, known for her calculated and precise approach, often criticizes Treseder's reckless abandon, leading to heated exchanges both on and off the track.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A rivalry born from consistently battling each other for podium positions. Each driver has taken wins from the other, creating a tense and competitive atmosphere whenever they are on the same circuit.

quirks: Always wears the same faded Bebeto Tyres cap during practice sessions, claiming it brings him good luck.
Refuses to eat anything green on race days, believing it brings bad luck.
Listens to a specific AC/DC song (Highway to Hell) just before getting into the car, to get him in the 'right' mindset.
famousQuote: You gotta risk it to biscuit it!
careerHighlight: Winning the 2019 Phillip Island Grand Prix after starting from the back of the grid due to a qualifying penalty. He carved his way through the field with a series of daring overtakes, showcasing his raw talent and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 2021 Bathurst 1000, denying himself and his team a surefire victory and earning him widespread criticism for his costly error.
